scope: Ironclad / Geo Lumine / Act 1 / PC A0
policy: Inventory of current production wiring, not a runtime admission switch or a claim of per-item platform acceptance. Any scope change must update this file and its evidence.

cards.limitation: 75 base/upgraded ordinary executions and focused interactions covered locally; full source/queue/RNG/acquisition parity and natural per-item platform evidence remain required.

generatedCards.limitation: Statuses and curses do not count toward the required 75 class cards.

enemies.limitation: Encounter construction coverage does not establish every AI branch, source parity or natural victory.

encounters.limitation: 14 normal + 3 elite + 1 Boss combinations; topology/selection/RNG parity remains open. A populated ID does not prove original encounter rules.

events.limitation: Restricted seven-event pool; not the full original pool. Per-option natural eligibility and real-game execution remain pending.

relics.limitation: Restricted relic pool; acquisition route and effect must both be verified. Shop-only effects use merchant rules.

potions.limitation: Six obtainable Ironclad potions; rare bucket unavailable, never rerolled. Poison Potion is Silent-exclusive and excluded.

bosses.limitation: One Boss on floor 16, separate treasure on 17. M2 completion does not prove every Guardian transition.

events.eligibility: remove requires deck size > 0; final card may be removed
take_gold requires a base damage effect >= 10; purge follows sacrifice
